close_reason: Removed Clone derive from LmdbBlockDb to prevent Drop races on OPEN_PATHS
description:
LmdbBlockDb derives Clone but Drop removes the path from OPEN_PATHS on every clone drop. When any clone is dropped, the path is erased from the global set even though the original handle and other clones still hold the environment open. A second LmdbBlockDb::open at the same path then succeeds, opening LMDB twice on the same file, which is undefined behaviour per LMDB's single-reader/writer model.

Trigger: open an LmdbBlockDb, clone it, drop the clone, then call LmdbBlockDb::open at the same path again.

Fix: wrap the inner Arc<heed::Env> in a newtype that removes the path from OPEN_PATHS only when the last Arc reference is dropped (Arc strong_count == 0 in Drop), or implement Clone manually to not touch OPEN_PATHS and only remove the path in Drop when Arc::strong_count == 1.
title: lmdb: Clone+Drop breaks single-open invariant
